extracted.name: Peanut Butter Playdough
extracted.description: A no-cook peanut butter confection, using just 4 ingredients, that kids can play with and eat!
instruction_lines: Cream together confectioners’ sugar and peanut butter in a large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Beat in honey. Mix in milk powder until incorporated.
Divide dough into 15 equal portions. Store in resealable plastic bags in the refrigerator or freezer until ready to use.
